jobs.title: Junior SEO Specialist
jobs.description: About Axipro Axipro gets fast-growing B2B companies ready for their security and compliance audits: SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, GDPR and more, plus penetration testing. We’ve helped 300+ companies get compliant, with a team of 35+ people and entities in Bahrain, the UK and the US. We’re a Drata Elite Partner, partner with Vanta, and are CREST certified. Our pitch is simple: readiness in about six weeks, real humans doing the work, and fixed fees starting at $4,000. About the role You’ll run ’s organic search and AI visibility day to day, so our Head of Growth can focus on other opportunities. He sets the strategy and signs off the work; you do the research, write the briefs and drafts, refresh what’s already ranking, and report on what’s moving. You’ll work alongside a small growth team: a web editor who publishes and builds pages in Elementor, an outreach specialist who handles link building and media placements, and a partnerships assistant. You’ll report to the Head of Growth and Partnerships. We use AI heavily, with our own Claude-based workflows for outlines, drafts and refresh briefs. We’re not hiring someone to paste in AI output. We want someone with judgement: someone who can tell when a draft is wrong, thin or off-brand, fix it, and add something a reader hasn’t seen before. What you'll do Most of your time goes on improving pages we already have and building the new ones we need. AreaShare of time Content refreshes30%New articles and pages30%Research, AI visibility and competitors15%Technical SEO and reporting15%Content syndication10% Content refreshes Find the pages worth updating in Google Search Console: ranking drops, pages stuck in positions 5 to 20, high impressions with low click-through. Write clear refresh briefs, including the new copy ready to paste in, and hand them to the web editor. Track before-and-after results for every page you touch. Flag weak, low-traffic pages for pruning or redirecting. New articles and pages Do keyword and topic research, and check for cannibalisation before proposing anything new. Produce articles through our AI-assisted workflow, then edit, fact-check and sharpen them so they’re genuinely useful to a compliance buyer. Build new service, framework and location pages as part of our localised SEO strategy for the US, UK and GCC. Send technical pieces to our GRC team for an expert review before they go live. Research, AI visibility and competitors Run our monthly AI visibility check (who ChatGPT and other AI tools cite for our key prompts) and write a short summary of what changed and why. Track what competing consultancies and audit firms publish and rank for. Get Axipro listed in the directories and review sites that AI answers cite. Technical SEO and reporting Monitor Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools for indexing, crawl and redirect issues. Fix the simple ones and flag the rest. Keep internal linking and schema in good shape. Send a one-page monthly report covering rankings, organic leads, refresh results and AI citations. Content syndication Turn our best articles into LinkedIn articles and posts, and republish them where the rules allow. What this role doesn't cover Other people on the team own these, so you won’t need to: Publishing and building pages in WordPress and Elementor Link-building outreach and media placements Partnership outreach Paid ads Conversion work such as CTAs and forms What we're looking for Must-haves 1 to 3 years of hands-on SEO, with pages you can show that you researched, wrote or refreshed, and that improved Confident with Google Search Console and at least one keyword tool (DataForSEO, Ahrefs, Semrush or similar) Excellent written English, and the ability to make a technical topic clear without padding it Comfortable using AI tools, and critical of what they produce: you check facts, cut fluff and add real insight Organised and self-directed: you can work through a weekly list without being chased, and you flag problems early Nice-to-haves Experience in B2B, SaaS or cybersecurity content Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar frameworks Some understanding of AI search visibility (GEO), schema and technical SEO WordPress basics How we'll measure success We’ll look at results, not hours: Pages refreshed each month, and the change in their rankings and clicks New articles and pages published Priority keywords ranking in the top 10 Leads coming from organic search Axipro’s share of citations in AI answers for our tracked prompts Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.description: 저희가 하려는 일 “고객의 매출을 책임지는 CRM 사업, 처음부터 함께 이끌 리더를 찾습니다.” 고객이 없는 기업은 없습니다. 그리고 기업을 오래 키우는 건 결국 다시 찾아오는 단골입니다. 그런데 많은 브랜드는 새 고객을 데려오는 퍼포먼스 마케팅에 집중합니다. 단골이 중요하다는 건 모두 알지만, 고객 데이터를 분석하고 개인화된 CRM을 실행하기에는 사람도 방법도 부족합니다. 저희는 고객사를 대신해 이 일을 해내는 팀입니다. 고객 중심의 마케팅을 말이 아니라 실행으로 만듭니다. 고객이 채팅으로 “이 상품 재입고 되나요?”라고 묻습니다. 대부분의 브랜드에서 이 질문은 답변으로 끝납니다. 채널톡에서는 이 질문이 CRM 캠페인의 시작이 될 수 있습니다. 재입고되는 순간 해당 고객에게 알림을 보내고, 구매로 연결하는 것입니다. 채널톡에는 상담, 고객 정보, 행동, 구매, 메시지 데이터가 모여 있습니다. 고객과의 대화에서 발견한 니즈를 CRM으로 연결해 실제 매출을 만들 수 있습니다. 이미 채널톡을 사용하는 25만 개 고객사와 바로 시작할 수 있습니다. 여기에 AI를 더하면 수많은 고객의 니즈를 분석하고, 고객 한 명 한 명에게 맞는 메시지와 대화를 통해 구매 전환을 이끌어낼 수 있습니다. 저희는 고객사의 CRM을 직접 진단하고, 전략을 설계하고, 캠페인을 운영하며, 실제 매출 성과까지 책임지는 새로운 사업을 시작합니다. 이 일은 채널톡의 다음 성장축입니다. 고객사의 매출이 오르는 만큼 채널톡도 함께 성장합니다. 한국과 일본에서 동시에 시작하며, 합류하시는 분은 [CSO 직속]으로 초기 사업을 구축하고, 사업 전체를 이끌게 됩니다. 예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.  

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

 

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다. 

  • 크래프톤은 2022년부터 사회 공헌 사업의 일환으로 ‘크래프톤 정글’을 출범하여 기술 산업의 미래 인재, SW 개발자를 양성해오고 있습니다.
  • 크래프톤 정글은 경기도 용인에 위치한 크래프톤 정글 캠퍼스에서, 자기 주도적 학습과 몰입 경험, 팀 기반의 프로젝트 수행을 바탕으로 기본기가 탄탄한 개발자로 성장하게 하는 교육 과정을 운영하고 있습니다.
  • Jungle Operations & Outreach Team은 정글의 사업을 관리하며, 정글 브랜드 관리, 교육생 모집을 위한 마케팅 캠페인 실행, 지원 및 선발 절차, 교육 과정의 주요 행사, 교육생 지원과 같은 크래프톤 정글의 전반적인 사업과 운영을 담당합니다.
  • 정글의 지속 성장을 위하여 더 효과적인 마케팅 운영안을 설계/실행하고, 팀과 협업하여 정글을 성장시키는 여정에 참여하고 싶은 분을 기다립니다.

 

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

Jungle Operations & Outreach Team은 동료를 존중하는 태도와 끈기 있고 성숙한 사고, 긍정적인 에너지를 바탕으로 팀의 방향성에 맞추어 적극적으로 협력하는 팀 플레이어를 찾고 있습니다.

  • [주요 역할]
    • 정글 교육 과정의 성과 극대화를 위하여 효과적인 캠페인 전략을 기획/실행하며, 타 사례와 정글의 캠페인 결과를 분석하고, 더 효과적인 실행 방안을 도출합니다.
    • 캠페인 정성/정량 데이터를 수집하고, 데이터 기반의 성과 분석 프로세스 및 대시보드 구축을 실행합니다.
    • 교육생 모집 선발, 학사운영 및 입소식, 수료식, 발표회 등 주요 교육 행사와 프로그램의 준비 및 실행, 운영을 지원합니다.
    • 교육과정이 원활하게 운영될 수 있도록 기타 운영 업무 전반을 지원합니다.
  • 이 직무를 통해 이런 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
    • 교육 사업 기반의 캠페인 설계 및 실행, 교육 사업 분야에 대한 전문적 인사이트와 업무 경력을 축적할 수 있습니다.

More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. Operating Principles Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together: Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet. We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team. AI-First by Default We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate. That means more than using the tools. We expect you to: Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster. Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you. Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet. Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place. We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment. Team Overview Deepgram recently opened its APAC headquarters in Singapore, and the region is one of our fastest-moving markets. You’ll build the APAC marketing function from zero, partnering closely with the APAC GM and regional sales leadership to shape and execute the regional plan. As part of the global Events & Field Marketing team, you’ll get the playbooks, brand assets, budget framework and coaching to help you move fast. Your job is to make Deepgram visible and credible across the region through technical community and partner motions, and to turn that presence into pipeline. As the senior marketer in region, you're also marketing's local point of contact: you'll work with our APAC PR agency and partner with global Brand, Web, and Product Marketing to keep regional messaging local and consistent. Key Goals Ship an APAC field and events plan and budget, agreed with regional sales leadership, with reserve held for in-quarter opportunities Launch a recurring technical community program out of Singapore, India, and Australia, with steady attendance from developers, builders and customers Stand up repeatable joint field programs with cloud, technology, and channel partners, each with shared pipeline goals and tracking Grow program-sourced and program-influenced pipeline and new logos across APAC Localize global "event-in-a-box" kits for priority markets and follow up with every lead fast Put a live APAC customer proof library (stories, case studies, references) into active use by sales aligned to global Marketing Team. Work with global Brand Team to properly represent APAC on the website: a regional landing page, local customer logos, case studies, proof points, product news and team presence. Deliver executive roundtables, customer dinners, and sponsorships, on time and on budget, reporting spend, attendance, and pipeline against plan Minimum Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities Plans and runs field and event programs end to end, from small executive dinners to large sponsorships, on time and on budget Builds community technical audiences choose to attend: hands-on content, credible speakers, and real builders in the room Designs partner marketing motions (joint programs, co-marketing, co-sell) with shared goals and measurable pipeline Partners with sales to tie every program in the quarterly plan to pipeline Adapts global playbooks to local markets across language, culture, format, and buyer expectations, and knows the APAC vendor landscape Operates AI-native: designs Human+AI workflows for planning, logistics, follow-up, and reporting, and builds systems that eliminate recurring event work instead of redoing it each time Works self-directed as the first in region, across time zones with a US-based team; travels across the region regularly (roughly 30-40%) Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have, not required) Typically ~3–6 years in field or event marketing covering APAC, or equivalent demonstrated experience Background in B2B SaaS, developer-focused, or AI/infrastructure marketing Co-marketing experience with technical partners Experience working with PR agencies or supporting regional communications Professional proficiency in an additional regional language (e.g., Bahasa, Mandarin) We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Marketing Engineer | Sweden | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability. As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them. As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey. This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value. What You'll Be Doing: Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders. Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams. Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators. Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable. Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels. Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance. Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices. Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation. Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them. Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities. Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders. Use automation & AI to scale technical content Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools. Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams. What Makes You a Great Fit: 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar). Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year. Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams. Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories. Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars. Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style. Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering. High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion. Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation. Bonus Points For: Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering. Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing. Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools. Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills. Compensation & Rewards: In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-D

jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability. As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them. As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey. This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value. What You'll Be Doing: Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders. Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams. Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators. Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable. Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels. Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance. Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices. Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation. Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them. Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities. Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders. Use automation & AI to scale technical content Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools. Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams. What Makes You a Great Fit: 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar). Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year. Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams. Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories. Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars. Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style. Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering. High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion. Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation. Bonus Points For: Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering. Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing. Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools. Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills. Compensation & Rewards: In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 117,600 - EUR 141,120. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. jobs.title: Virtual Assistant - AI, Marketing and Operations
jobs.description: Virtual Assistant: Marketing and Operations About Frontier: At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US based startups and high growth companies. About the Role We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a US-based commercial real estate brokerage team with marketing, research, listing management, and day-to-day administrative tasks. This role is ideal for someone who goes beyond basic AI prompting and understands how to use tools like ChatGPT and other AI platforms to get things done more efficiently. You'll be expected to use AI to research information, organize data, create and refine content, simplify repetitive tasks, and identify opportunities to improve existing workflows. You'll also support marketing activities, online property listings, document preparation, and general administrative tasks. While marketing experience is valuable, we're particularly interested in candidates who are comfortable experimenting with AI tools, figuring out how to solve unfamiliar problems, and turning ideas into practical solutions. Key Responsibilities 1. Marketing & Content Support Create and update marketing materials, presentations, brochures, flyers, and promotional content using existing templates and digital tools. Use AI tools to assist with drafting property descriptions, marketing copy, email campaigns, research summaries, and other content. Review and edit AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and a professional tone before sharing or publishing. Coordinate property images, maps, aerial imagery, and other visual assets for marketing materials. Assist with email marketing campaigns, property announcements, and promotional activities. Help coordinate the preparation and updating of property signage. 2. AI & Digital Tools Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant platforms to streamline research, drafting, data organization, and repetitive administrative work. Develop effective prompts and workflows to generate useful, accurate outputs for day-to-day tasks. Verify AI-generated information against reliable sources rather than relying on unverified outputs. Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support team productivity. Learn and adapt to new software, platforms, and workflows as business needs evolve. 3. Research & Data Management Conduct online research to gather property details, market information, comparable listings, and other relevant data. Maintain and update internal databases, spreadsheets, contact lists, and property records. Collect, organize, and verify information from multiple sources. Ensure data is accurate, complete, and consistently formatted. Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or errors and follow up as needed. 4. Listing & Administrative Support Create and update online listings using approved information, templates, and workflows. Maintain accurate property details, descriptions, pricing, images, and supporting documents across relevant platforms. Prepare and organize documents using established templates. Assist with sending documents through DocuSign and tracking signatures or outstanding paperwork. Support the preparation of listing agreements and other brokerage documents using approved templates and instructions. Keep marketing assets, property records, and administrative documents organized and easy to access. Track pending tasks, follow up on outstanding items, and provide general support to the brokerage team. Requirements Experience in virtual assistance, administrative support, marketing coordination, research, data management, or a similar role. Strong experience in AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, writing, content creation, and administrative workflows. Strong attention to detail and the ability to verify information before using or sharing it. Good written English and the ability to produce clear, professional content. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, online databases, document management tools, and web-based platforms. Resourceful and quick to learn new software and processes. Able to work independently in a remote environment and communicate proactively with a US-based team. Nice to Have Experience with commercial real estate, property management, or real estate marketing. Familiarity with platforms such as Buildout, CoStar, LoopNet, or Crexi. Experience with Canva or similar tools for creating marketing materials. Familiarity with DocuSign, email marketing platforms, and CRM systems. Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting, including building repeatable workflows or using AI to improve productivity. Experience coordinating property imagery, maps, aerial photos, or signage. What We're Looking For AI-savvy: Comfortable using AI to improve the speed and quality of everyday work, while checking outputs carefully. Detail-oriented: Takes the time to verify facts, review documents, and catch inconsistencies. Proactive: Spots what needs to be done and follows through without constant supervision. Adaptable: Learns new platforms and workflows quickly, even without prior industry experience. Organized: Keeps information, files, and tasks structured and easy to track. Resourceful: Knows how to research unfamiliar topics, find reliable information, and solve problems independently. The ideal candidate combines strong administrative and marketing skills with practical AI experience and a willingness to learn.

jobs.title: AI Video Editor
jobs.description: Hi there! Do not apply until you have read this entire job posting. We can tell when someone hasn't, and those applications will not be considered. About Us Content Mindset is a small but growing video editing agency. We partner with social media teams to handle 100% of their video editing needs. You will be working alongside a team of editors, and you'll be getting edits that push you to grow as an editor. We are hiring a freelance short-form video editor dedicated to one of our clients: a software company that markets to e-commerce brands. The client posts 3 times per week, and you will be the editor behind those videos. The Style The main inspiration for this role is Rourke's Instagram page: Study it before you apply. Think cinematic AI-generated scenes, bold animated text, fast pacing, and motion graphics that keep every second visually interesting. We want videos that feel like they were made by someone who lives on the internet and genuinely loves what AI can do for video. What You'll Be Doing Editing 3 short-form vertical videos per week for our client Using AI tools to generate animations, visuals, and scenes that bring each script to life Building motion graphics: animated text, popups, callouts, and UI highlights Sourcing B-roll, including screen recording B-roll from e-commerce brand websites (storefronts, product pages, checkout flows) Adding and proofreading captions on every video Working with our team on review notes and revisions Pay This is a freelance role paid per video, at $50 USD per video . At 3 videos per week, that's $150 USD per week. We also give our editors a $10 weekly bonus, just for being a part of the team. Payment is always sent Friday evening PST. We also host our team meetings Friday evening PST. Requirements Adobe Premiere Pro 2026 (non-negotiable) Very comfortable using AI tools for video. You use AI image and video generators (Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, Luma, Veo, or similar) to create animations and scenes, and you keep up with new tools as they come out Strong motion graphics skills Comfortable sourcing B-roll and recording clean, high-quality screen recordings of websites (smooth scrolling, clean cursor movement, high resolution) Internet-native. You understand short-form, trends, retention, and what makes someone stop scrolling Excited about AI and always trying to get better as an editor. You take feedback well and actively look for ways to level up Very communicative and enjoys being part of a team Reliable turnaround. The client posts 3 times per week, so hitting deadlines matters Fluent / Almost Fluent English speaker Premiere captioning isn't the best with grammar, you'd be expected to correct this on your own Comfortable with large file sizes (50+ GB in some cases) Open to working with us long term Nice to have: experience editing for tech, software, or e-commerce brands. How to Apply The only way to apply is through our application form. Have 2 to 3 examples of your work ready, ideally videos where you used AI-generated visuals or motion graphics. APPLY HERE: If you do not fill out the form, we will not consider your application. We will reach out to people who are a good fit via email. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Marketing Executive
jobs.description: Marketing Executive — uPhone uPhone · Fully remote (work from anywhere) · Full-time · Apply to Posted 18 November 2026 · Open until 17 January 2027 Fully remote — work from anywhere in the world, with no country restriction. Compensation is competitive and negotiable based on experience. About uPhone uPhone is an eSIM marketplace built for modern travellers, available at (). The service is operated by Targa Limited, a company registered in Hong Kong. The team is small, remote-first, and based across Europe and Asia. uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card. What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. They scan it in iPhone or Android settings and can be connected in under two minutes, with no store visit. The physical SIM stays in the phone, so the home number remains available. Plans are data-only; calls and texts abroad are made over apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage. Monthly and yearly plans are available for trips of 30 days or more. Plans are listed from about $2, with no contract. uPhone publishes 24/7 customer support via live chat and email (the help centre cites a typical response time under two minutes), a 30-day unused-eSIM refund if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated, and a rating of 4.8/5 from 50,000+ travellers who trust the service. Company values, as stated on the About Us page: transparency (what you see is what you pay), simplicity (purchase to connected in under two minutes), reliability (24/7 support and a clear refund policy), and sustainability (digital eSIMs mean zero plastic waste). The role We are hiring a Marketing Executive to help more travellers discover uPhone eSIM and understand why it is a better option than airport SIM counters or expensive carrier roaming. You will plan and run day-to-day marketing across content, campaigns, and channels — from search and social to email, landing pages, and creative. This is a fully remote, full-time role — you can work from anywhere in the world. On a small team you will both think and do: brief or make assets, ship campaigns, watch the numbers, and iterate. The job is to explain a clear product (buy a plan, get a QR code, connect in minutes, keep your physical SIM) to people who are about to travel, and to do it accurately. Responsibilities - Plan, produce, and ship marketing that explains uPhone eSIM clearly: what it is, where it works (150+ countries; country, regional, and global plans), how to install it, and how it compares with roaming or a physical travel SIM. - Run or support campaigns across the channels we use to reach travellers, which may include search, social, email, content, and partner or affiliate activity. - Write and edit customer-facing copy for the website, landing pages, ads, emails, and social posts. Keep claims consistent with the site (plans from about $2, no hidden fees or contracts, 24/7 support, 30-day unused-eSIM refunds, data-only plans). - Help maintain a simple content calendar (guides, destination pages, FAQs, and campaign landing pages) that answers the questions travellers actually search for. - Track campaign and channel performance with the analytics and campaign tools the team uses, report what is working, and recommend changes. - Coordinate with business development on partner or co-marketing launches, and with support / product so campaigns do not over-promise on coverage, speed, or refunds. - Support brand consistency across and owned channels, following uPhone's existing brand and creative guidance. - Share regular updates on what is working, and agree priorities with the team. Requirements - Experience in a marketing executive, coordinator, or similar hands-on role, with examples of campaigns or content you have shipped — not only planned. - Strong writing in English, with care for accuracy and a traveller-friendly tone. - Comfortable using common marketing and analytics tools, and making decisions from basic performance data. - Able to manage several workstreams at once on a small, fully remote team, and to ask for help early when a claim, asset, or deadline is at risk. - Experience in at least one of: content, social, paid media, SEO, or email marketing. - You can be based anywhere in the world; there is no country restriction. You should have the legal right to work from where you live. Nice-to-haves - Experience marketing travel, telecom, e-commerce, or other digital consumer products. - Additional languages, especially those used by travellers in Europe and Asia. - Experience with SEO for destination or comparison content, or with affiliate / partnership marketing. - Basic design or video-editing skills for social and ad creative. - Familiarity with eSIM or mobile-connectivity products. What we offer - This is a fully remote, full-time role. You can work from anywhere in the world; there is no country restriction. - Flexible hours, coordinated with a small remote-first team. - Travel perks, as described on uPhone's careers page. - Real ownership and impact on a small team, with little unnecessary process. - Competitive pay, negotiable based on experience. Reference: UPH-MKT-2611 How to apply Email . Applications sent without the code word in the subject line will not be considered — this is how we check that candidates follow directions. How to find the code word 1. Search uPhone eSIM on Google. 2. Open the official site, (). 3. Go to the About Us () page. 4. Find the code word on that page. 5. Put that exact word in your email subject line. Subject line format: UPH-MKT-2611 — Marketing Executive — [code word from the About Us page] Please include - A short note on why you want to work at uPhone, and what you would do in this role. - Your CV / résumé (PDF). - Optional: a LinkedIn profile, portfolio, or relevant work samples. Do not ask us to tell you the code word. If you have followed the steps above, you will have it. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer, Japan
jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As a Customer Success Engineer, you'll expand your impact by partnering with customers in GitLab's group across APJ to help them get measurable value from GitLab through hands-on technical guidance and proactive enablement. You'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with customers over Zoom and email to improve adoption, unblock implementations, and apply DevSecOps best practices across the software delivery lifecycle. Working closely with Account Executives and Renewals Managers, you'll align technical recommendations to customer goals and help support renewals and expansion by demonstrating outcomes. You'll also contribute back to the broader GitLab team by sharing learnings through documentation and enablement content, while mentoring team members and customers through complex technical challenges. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, communicates clearly, and thrives in a remote, asynchronous environment. You're eager to grow into customer-facing technical leadership with strong mentorship and support from a collaborative team. What you’ll do Provide on-demand technical consultancy and solution guidance through Zoom and written channels, helping customers solve day-to-day issues and design and implement GitLab solutions for their DevSecOps workflows. Drive product adoption and measurable customer value across APJ accounts to support renewals and expansion. Deliver technical and architectural guidance across source code management, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and Agile planning to unblock implementations and improve adoption. Partner with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to align technical recommendations to customer objectives and account plans that support retention and growth. Plan and lead customer workshops, demos, and enablement sessions that help teams adopt GitLab confidently and drive measurable adoption and value, supporting renewals and expansion across APJ. Maintain and grow your specialty competency in GitLab capabilities and relevant DevSecOps tooling, staying current on new product features and patterns. Contribute to scalable enablement by improving documentation, sharing knowledge through internal and external channels (for example, tutorials or technical content), and mentoring team members and customers to build technical competency and adoption. Manage multiple customer engagements in parallel, prioritizing effectively and communicating status, risks, and next steps to keep implementations on track. What you’ll bring Experience providing technical consultancy and solution guidance through video calls and written channels, helping users or customers adopt technical solutions successfully. Familiarity with DevSecOps workflows and related practices across areas such as source code management, CI/CD, security, and Agile planning, with the ability to grow breadth over time. Hands-on technical background in software development, systems engineering, or similar technical environments, or equivalent practical experience. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and work effectively with customers, account teams, and cross-functional partners. Ability to lead or support workshops, demos, and enablement sessions that build confidence and drive adoption. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote, asynchronous environment while communicating status, risks, and next steps clearly. Interest in supporting customers across APJ and adapting to different cultures, working styles, and technical maturity levels. Must be based in Japan, with full working rights in Japan Must be fluent in Japanese and English About the team In this role, you'll support our customers across APJ, delivering workshops, demos, and best-practice guidance while contributing back to our shared documentation and enablement resources. For more on how we work, see Customer Success Engineering team handbook page . If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist
jobs.description: Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 230,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers. That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. As our new Paid Media Specialist, you'll plan, run, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns for Kinsta. You'll join our Performance Marketing team, report to the Paid Media Team Lead, and work closely with Demand Generation, Design, and RevOps to deliver a consistent volume of sign-ups and revenue that supports Kinsta's growth goals. It's a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable with data and enjoys testing new ideas. Your focus is Kinsta's paid social presence across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms. You'll reach the businesses, agencies, and enterprises that run their sites on WordPress, through campaigns that cover the full funnel from awareness to customer acquisition. You'll own campaigns from build to optimization, keep conversion tracking reliable, and turn performance data into clear recommendations. We work with teams across the globe, so you should be used to collaborating asynchronously and flexible enough to join the occasional early or late call. The ideal Kinsta Paid Media Specialist is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, proactive, and collaborative. What You Will Do: Plan, build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X, and other relevant platforms, covering the full funnel from awareness and demand generation to lead generation and customer acquisition. Monitor performance and continuously optimize targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, ad creatives, and landing pages, scaling what works while keeping acquisition costs efficient. Run audience research and competitive analysis to find new opportunities for growth. Develop and run A/B tests across ad messaging, creative assets, audiences, and landing pages. Own conversion tracking: implement, maintain, and troubleshoot it through Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and platform-specific pixels and tags, and work with marketing and technical teams to keep conversion events and attribution accurate. Analyze campaign performance using ad platform data, web analytics, and CRM reporting, and build reports and dashboards that share results and actionable insights. Collaborate with content, design, product marketing, and sales on ad copy, creative concepts, and campaign assets that match our messaging and business priorities. Support our paid media strategy: follow advertising trends and platform updates, and recommend ways to improve campaign efficiency, lead quality, and overall marketing ROI. Use AI tools to streamline research, reporting, ad copy, and creative ideation, automate repetitive tasks, and apply critical thinking to AI-generated recommendations so decisions stay grounded in accurate data and business objectives. What You Bring To The Role: 2-4 years of hands-on experience independently building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns, including on Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit, ideally in hosting, B2B technology, or a related industry. Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags. A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations. Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition. Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once. Bonus if you have: Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms. Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack. Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites. Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives. Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development. Our Benefits: Annual remote expense budget. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA. Compensation Additional Information Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy , including the transfer of your data to the United States. #LI-Remote, #IHSRemote

Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 We’re looking for a Technical Implementation Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers as a trusted partner and problem-solver, blending strong relationship management with a growing understanding of ClickUp’s platform and capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of customer success, solution strategy, and technical enablement, contributing to long-term growth, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. This role operates in an AI-native environment, and we expect TAMs at this level to use AI tools as a daily multiplier across account preparation, workflow analysis, solution design, follow-through, and customer enablement. TAMs at this level manage a defined book of business and own day-to-day execution for their accounts, while working closely with more senior TAMs and cross-functional partners on complex initiatives. jobs.title: Junior Copywriter
jobs.description: Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paper Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! Funny name, serious business We are a leading planet-conscious household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we've contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good. We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we're hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. A bit about the role We're looking for a Junior Copywriter based remotely in the Philippines to join our creative team and dig into the world of growth and paid advertising. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world. Which is, it turns out, a great thing to put in the world. If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in Joining a creative workshop with the AU creative strategist to brainstorm ideas for a new paid video campaign – and walking out with three concepts you're actually excited to write Reviewing performance data on a batch of still ads and rewriting three hooks to test new angles based on what the numbers were telling you Writing and submitting five paid social scripts (still and video) hitting the brief deadline with a day to spare Attending a prioritisation call to align on which ad concepts to develop next, and flagging a hooky idea you'd been thinking about Sitting in on a video review round with the video team, adjusting a script line that wasn't landing in the edit Let's talk about you You can write. This sounds obvious, but it matters. You have a feel for language, rhythm and tone – you know when a sentence is working and when it isn't. You've got some real copywriting experience (even if it's not a lot), and you're already good at matching your voice to a brand's. Crucially, you can write with humour and lightness without it feeling forced. Our tone is a lot of fun to write in, but it takes genuine instinct to pull off. You're curious about what makes ads work. You don't need a deep background in performance marketing – we'll teach you the things you don't know. But you need to be genuinely interested in learning. When someone shows you an ad that performed well and explains why, your instinct is to lean in, not tune out. You're the kind of person who thinks about why something catches your eye, why it works, and what might make it land differently. You're fast-paced and collaborative. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving team. You're comfortable working across multiple briefs, responding to feedback quickly, and jumping into a workshop or prioritisation call and actually contributing. You don't need every detail spelled out before you start, and you communicate proactively when things aren't clear or capacity is getting tight. You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence – us too! Why should you work with us? First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We're in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that's why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn't be more proud of that. Have you made it this far? If you're still reading, we think there's a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here's the thing, though – research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don't check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.title: Haitian Creole Language Specialist - AI Trainer
jobs.description: Are you a Haitian Creole language specialist eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural preservation. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can better understand the phonetics, grammar, vocabulary, and cultural nuances of Haitian Creole—bridging gaps in global accessibility and fostering authentic cross-cultural exchange. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for Haitian Creole language specialists who live and breathe grammar, orthography, regionalisms, intonation patterns, idiomatic expressions, and cultural references unique to Haiti. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like colloquial expressions, contextual interpretation, tone adaptation, syntactic accuracy, and semantic precision—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning. On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Haitian Creole across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics. A degree in Linguistics, Translation, Haitian Creole Language, Literature, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, localization, or editorial work signals fit. Job Overview Project Coordinators work under the direction of a project manager to coordinate the logistics of a specific project on a more granular level. jobs.title: Māori Language Specialist - AI Trainer
jobs.description: Are you an experienced Māori language professional eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple chatbots into powerful engines of learning, communication, and cultural understanding. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and contextually rich Māori experiences across education, accessibility, and global communication. That training data begins with you—your expertise will help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for a highly skilled Māori language specialist who can bring linguistic depth, cultural context, and precision to training data. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools, evaluate and refine Māori text outputs, and provide expert feedback on grammar, syntax, semantics, style, and cultural appropriateness to strengthen model performance. On a typical day, you will review and annotate Māori content, assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy and fluency, identify and document error patterns, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and linguistic guidelines. Fluency in Māori is required, along with demonstrated experience in translation, linguistics, language teaching, editing, or related professional work. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills, cultural knowledge, and attention to detail are essential. Ready to channel your Māori expertise into building the AI tools of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will support millions of Māori speakers worldwide. We offer a pay range of $8 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and stable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Qualifications and Job Requirements Proven track record as a Full-Stack Software Engineer building modern web applications, scalable backend APIs, and working with relational databases. Advanced SQL proficiency alongside hands-on scripting/analytical experience in Python, R, or equivalent modern data tools. Practical foundation in experimental design, A/B testing methodologies, statistical inference, and causal reasoning. Hands-on experience implementing product analytics instrumentation, event pipelines, and auditing data quality. Solid experience architecting third-party integrations using webhooks, APIs, and event-driven patterns. Strong ability to translate complex data findings and technical tradeoffs into actionable business and product insights. jobs.title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
jobs.description: Description BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve. This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well. The Opportunity We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made. You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency. This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand. What You'll Own Email & Retention Design Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms Web Creative & CRO Support Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs Social & Ad Creative Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed Process & Quality Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs) Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines Who You Are Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role: An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right. What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days: You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests Must-Have: 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.) A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results Advanced proficiency in Figma Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs) Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team Strong Differentiators: Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar) Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok) Agency background preferred This role is fully remote. Time Commitment and Availability Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST Compensation $20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate. jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role Overview As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns. Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required. Core Responsibilities Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets. Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes. Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets. Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns. Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting. Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy. Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels. Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates. Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions. Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims. Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets. Requirements Background & Experience At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish. A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions. Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand. Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives. Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail. Fluency in English; German is a plus. Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome. Benefits What Makes You A Great Fit At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results. Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools. Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success. Why Join Us? Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story. Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale. Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company. Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team. Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location). Ready to Move the Needle? If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.
